rate_limits: Default 20 concurrent requests per token (~20 req/s derived); concurrency scales with plan. Exceeding returns HTTP 429.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Auditor correct. Docs publish default 20 concurrent (~20 RPS derived) per token (https://crawlbase.com/docs/rate-limits); Crawling API proxy mode also states 20 req/s (https://crawlbase.com/docs/crawling-api). Original 'not published' is wrong. example: Auditor correct. Without format=json the body is the raw target content and metadata is in headers; JSON envelope needs format=json and uses cb_status (formerly pc_status), not pc_status (https://crawlbase.com/docs/crawling-api).
